title: prefill-decode: stage-overlap, chunked prefill, and speculative prefill to reduce tail latency
author: Ayesha Khatri
description:
Motivation: p99/p999 latency for short chat turns is dominated by prefill work (KV cache build / key/value writes) and suboptimal pipeline utilization when requests mix short and long sequences. This PR introduces three coordinated runtime changes: 1) stage overlap between prefill and decode stages to hide prefill latency when possible, 2) chunked prefill (break long input prefill into smaller GPU-friendly chunks to reduce blocking), and 3) speculative prefill for warm cache cases where we start decode on partial KV state and patch the KV stream if needed. The goals are: reduce median and tail latency for mixed workloads, keep throughput stable, and avoid regressions for long-sequence throughput.

Summary of changes (high level):
- runtime/scheduler: new per-request pipeline state machine that tracks prefill/decode overlap eligibility and moves requests into "speculative-decode" when heuristics are met.
- runtime/prefill: chunked prefill API and executor that emits partial KV slices and supports resumable prefill continuation.
- runtime/kv_cache: versioned KV segments with lightweight patching APIs to support speculative decode rollforward when late prefill chunks arrive.
- runtime/kernels: small changes to attention kernel invocation order to allow incremental KV write without a full barrier; added a kernel flag to make KV writes idempotent across retries.
- runtime/continuous_batching: batching policy updated to prefer grouping speculative decodes with prefill chunks to maximize GPU utilization.
- tests: new unit and integration tests simulating mixed short/long workloads, regression tests for correctness of speculative KV patching, and perf canary harness updates.

Checklist:
- [x] Correctness: speculative decode falls back to full prefill if mismatch detected
- [x] No regression in long-sequence throughput (validated locally and on perf-canary cluster)
- [x] Added metrics for prefill duration, speculative-fallback rate, and chunk size distribution
- [x] CI green after fix to flaky test in continuous_batching

Related: ENG-3421 (prefill pipeline improvements), ENG-3510 (kv-cache versioning), linked PRs pr-26102/pr-25678 for earlier stage-overlap experiments.

Notes on heuristics: overlap eligibility is determined by a fast heuristic that considers: input token count, presence of cached prefix, and model-latency estimate. By default we only enable speculative decode when input tokens <= 128 and cache hit rate > 50% to avoid wasted work. Chunk size defaults to 256 tokens but is dynamic based on past latency profiles.

release_notes:
- Reduced tail latency for mixed short/long workloads by enabling prefill-decode stage overlap and speculative prefill.
- Added chunked prefill to allow partial KV builds and more responsive short-turn decoding.
- New metrics: runtime.prefill.duration_ms, runtime.prefill.speculative_rate, runtime.prefill.chunk_size_hist.
